'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds Robbie Hendon DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Robbie Hendon]] at [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robbie Hendon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Imperial Entanglements Hendon D 3.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014806/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
